Name: Fairy Rings
Author: KaileyStardew
Description:
Build two types of fairy rings, and leave offerings in exchange for mushrooms!

The Fairy Rings are buildings available from The Wizard's shop.

The regular Fairy Ring accepts offerings of fruit and flowers, and will give most mushrooms in exchange. The Bone Fairy Ring accepts offerings of bones and gemstones, and will give poisonous and common mushrooms in exchange.

Items are offered by interacting with the corners of the fairy ring with collision, except for the bottom-right corner where mushrooms are picked up. A glowing sigil around the outside of the fairy ring indicates the offering was put in the correct place. Items are exchanged overnight.

From time to time, the fae might welcome guests. A glowing sigil in the middle of the fairy ring means you can visit and explore; the fae realm is full of forage, resources, and mysterious frogs, but bringing a weapon may be wise...

[img]https://i.ibb.co/MVR34cc/config-1.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Mushroom Quality:[/b] Foraging Skill Based, None, Silver, Gold, Iridium. Whether the quality of mushrooms is based on foraging skill or is static.
[*][b]Portal Availability:[/b] Luck Based, Random, Always, Never. When the portal to the fae realm is open. When Luck Based is selected, the Fairy Ring will be open on good luck days and the Bone Fairy Ring will be open on bad luck days.
[*][b]Random Portal Chance:[/b] Numerical from 1 to 90%. The percent chance that the portal will be open, if Portal Availability is set to Random.
[*][b]Mysterious Frog Chance:[/b] Numerical from 1 to 100%. The percent chance that each mysterious frog has to spawn in the fae realm.
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/JmHVzN3/compatibility.png[/img][list]
[*]Most modded mushrooms, fruit, etc are compatible and will be exchanged. I have not found any incompatible modded items while testing, but it is possible if an author did not use a typical item category or context tag. 
[*]For recolour compatibility, see [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14371]Kailey's Tilesheets﻿[/url]﻿.
[/list]
If reporting a compatibility issue, please be specific (eg, exactly which item isn't accepted), and include a link to the other mod and your SMAPI log.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/ZW8hY5N/installation-1.png[/img][list]
[*]Install all the requirements above.
[*]Unzip Fairy Rings into Stardew Valley/Mods. The parent folder contains both the Content Patcher and FTM components.
[/list]
The mod can be safely uninstalled at any point by removing it from the Mods folder. When loading a save for the first time after removal, SMAPI will log warnings that the fae realm maps cannot be found, and the fairy rings will be replaced with harmless placeholder error buildings. These error buildings can be safely demolished through the build menu at Robin or The Wizard's shops, and you can continue playing as usual.



If something has gone wrong, I [b]need [/b]a SMAPI log to help you. See smapi.io/log for instructions.
It is not possible to troubleshoot without a log. Thank you for helping me help you!
